svg.text: Block 23 long x 12 wide x 12 tall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rod hole 8.2 dia and dipole hole 10.2 dia, 10 mm apart centre to

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: centre, both straight through the 12 mm height.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print flat with the holes upright; ream with a drill if tight.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: both clips slide over the rod top; the dipole slides through

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: them so its centre is level with the rod top (1,000 mm above grade).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clip centres 925 and 985 mm above grade; a cable tie above and below

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the rod and dipole each slide through by hand, without play.
